nodes.excerpt: Five-day "Cultural Heritage Protection for Law Enforcement" course, four sessions a day (9-4). A PDF overview came first, then all 20 sessions as standalone decks built on the Port Security Icebreaker template (PCCP House Style). Sister course: Controlled Deliveries Course. Part of Training Courses.

nodes.title: UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data
nodes.excerpt: 2026 workbook of open-source press seizure reports across cocaine, NSA, methamphetamine, cannabis, heroin-opium and cigarettes. Turned into a searchable dashboard in CEN Seizure Analysis. Similar in spirit to Seizure Watch.

nodes.title: WCO CEN nCEN Data
nodes.excerpt: Seizure case exports from the WCO Customs Enforcement Network (operation CONTAINERcomm 3). Analysed in CEN Seizure Analysis, scored with Risk Scoring, stored in a private GitHub repo, summarised monthly in CEN Monthly Bulletin. Seizure Watch compares its open-source findings against it.

nodes.title: Brain Graph
nodes.excerpt: This project: an interactive graph of markdown notes that runs on iPad, published with the GitHub Pages Workflow from the brain-graph repo on GitHub, built with Claude Code. The notes you are looking at are its content. Entry point: Start Here. Possible next step: a J.A.R.V.I.S.-style chat and voice layer.

nodes.title: CEN Monthly Bulletin
nodes.excerpt: One-page A4 bulletin of the previous month's seizures, produced on the 1st of each month by a scheduled task and saved in the CEN-nCEN-seizure-data GitHub repo. Data from WCO CEN nCEN Data via CEN Seizure Analysis; branded in the PCCP House Style.

nodes.title: CEN Seizure Risk Board
